# [PR #13068] [None][feat] Add FP4 MLA

source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/13068
state: open | updated: 2026-09-26T03:38:03Z
labels: 

## 正文

Allocate a standalone BF16 tensor indexed by seq_slot for storing recent tokens at full precision. Plumb seq_slots from SeqSlotManager through attention metadata with CUDA graph compatible GPU tensors. Add ownership tracking to verify slot correctness during decode.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added FP4 quantization support for Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) models with per-request state management.

## Walkthrough

The changes introduce FP4-only, high-precision KV cache support for MLA attention. New metadata fields track per-request KV slot ownership and a separate BF16 pool stores high-precision data. Request preparation propagates slot information and warmup flags to the attention backend.

## Changes

|Cohort / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Attention Metadata & High-Precision KV Infrastructure** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/trtllm.py`|Added five new fields to `TrtllmAttentionMetadata` for FP4 MLA support: `seq_slots`, `seq_slots_cpu`, `is_warmup`, `high_precision_kv_pool`, and `high_precision_slots_owners`. Extended `_post_init_with_buffers` to conditionally allocate these resources when KV cache uses FP4. Added `_update_high_precision_kv_for_fp4_mla` method for debug ownership tracking (context/decode phases with TODO for actual KV logic). Integrated high-precision KV update into `forward` path.|
|**Request Preparation & Seq-Slots Propagation** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/model_engine.py`|Extended `_prepare_tp_inputs`, `_prepare_tp_inputs_no_cache`, and `_prepare_star_attention_inputs` to collect per-request `seq_slots` from `request.py_seq_slot` with fallback to `0`. Propagate `is_warmup` flag to attention metadata. Copy collected `seq_slots` from Python lists into `attn_metadata.seq_slots_cpu` and then into device tensor `attn_metadata.seq_slots` (non-blocking transfer).|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes
